questions.q: What is the note on the middle line of the alto clef?
questions.why: The alto clef places middle C on the middle line.

questions.q: Which interval is C up to A?
questions.why: C to A is 9 semitones and A is in the C major scale: a major 6th.

questions.q: A clarinet in B♭ is written C. Which note sounds?
questions.why: B♭ instruments sound a major 2nd lower than written.

questions.q: Describe the difference between an appoggiatura and an acciaccatura.
questions.model: An appoggiatura is a leaning grace note that takes part of the main note's value and often creates a dissonance; an acciaccatura is a very quick crushed note, written with a slash, played just before the beat.
points: appoggiatura takes time/leans onto main note
